remarks: This Coastal CT colonial in The Tokeneke Association has 5 bedrooms, one on 1st floor, four on 2nd. Gracious living spaces include formal living room, spacious office, formal dining and casual dining. Chefs kitchen is open to casual dining and casual gathering room with fireplace. Large mudroom from garage and back entrance with separate laundry. Main bedroom is spacious and private. En-suite bath and two walk-in closets. Second floor includes another en-suite bedroom and two additional bedrooms that share a newly renovated hall bath. There is a sitting/work area and abundant storage on the second floor. Basement is finished with wine room, casual sitting area and more storage. Two car garage attached with a third in the "barn" that allows even more storage. Beautiful stone patio surrounded by stone wall and paths and extensive green yard.
